notes.title: Update 0.42.0
notes.content:
Horde Mode

 The kill badge introduced in 0.41.0 now only counts when flying enemies and armored mages are killed, as it prevents the freedom to use a variety of weapons.
 The score screen at the end of a horde has been adjusted.


Weapons

 Ammo consumption for freeze grenade has been changed from 50 to 75.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where bullets affected by gravity would slip through the ground.
 Fixed an issue where the weapon wheel would fire if closed immediately after selecting a two-handed weapon with the weapon wheel.
 Fixed an issue where the sun's time lapse would not slow down while the weapon wheel was open.
 Fixed an issue where the flame effect produced when the flame launcher's bullets stuck to an enemy was misaligned.

notes.title: update 0.41.2
notes.content:
Adjustment

 The time lapse of day and night is now constant, even in slow motion.
 The speed of looking through the monocular is now constant, even in slow motion.

Bug fixes

 Fixed an issue where the controls would not work.
 Game time no longer elapses when opening the store in campaign mode.

notes.title: update 0.41.1
notes.content: Improved responsiveness between game and rendering threads.

notes.title: update 0.41.0
notes.content:
Weapons

 Custerbow bullets have been changed to sticky bombs only, making it a weapon whose distance is adjusted by hold time.
 Plasmagun's bullet velocity has been increased from 0.5 to 0.75.
 The ammunition consumption of the Punch's charge attack has been increased from 50 to 75
 The attack power of the Handcannon has been reduced from 5-40 to 5.

Enemies

 Headshots used to drop additional gibs, but this has been eliminated.

Parkour

 Releasing a move input when performing a frontal grab action will now maintain the grab action.
 Tactical sprint is now maintained when jumping or hitting a wall.

Episode Mode

 Added Complete Rate to the clear screen.

Horde Mode

 The number of kill bonuses that add time is now called a kill badge, and the number of kill badges earned now adds to the score.
 The maximum number of armor mages spawned has been set to 5.
 The spawn algorithm has been revised so that floating enemies do not spawn repeatedly.

Settings

 FOV, Brightness, and Contrast settings have been moved to General.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where item acquisition rates and enemy kills were not being recorded correctly when saving at checkpoints.
 Fixed an issue where screen effects would not play when attacks were mitigated with armor.
 Numerous other bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: update 0.40.3
notes.content:
Bug Fix

 Fixed an issue that broke actor placement when playing E1M3.
 Fixed an issue that would freeze when opening SteamOverlay during a game.
 Fixed an issue where the fully charged state would be canceled if the combo rank was lowered while the weapon was being charged.

notes.title: update 0.40.2
notes.content:
Bug fixes.

 Fixed pathfinding algorithm to prevent falling.
 Fixed an issue where the pathfinding algorithm was causing poor performance.

notes.title: Update 0.40.1
notes.content: Fixed a problem with fast animation when falling.

notes.title: Update 0.40.0
notes.content:
UI

 Drop shadows are now displayed on some UI parts to improve visibility.

Weapons

 A special SE will now sound when running out of ammunition.
 Some weapon designs have been adjusted.
 Sprint-only sprites have been added to some weapons.

Enemies

 Enemies now drop more Gibs when killed by headshots than usual.

Episode Mode

 Play time is now counted while using the store.

Horde Mode

 Incremental time for defeating armor mages has been returned to 10 seconds.
 It is now possible to return to the weapon selection screen during the start countdown.
 After acquiring the weapon selected at the start, another weapon will no longer spawn.

Other

 Numerous performance issues have been fixed.
 Numerous gameplay bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: update 0.39.0
notes.content:
Horde Mode

 To increase the specific weight of the meat score addition, it is now x10 per gram.

Weapons

 The chainshotgun has been replaced with a flame launcher that fires sticky fire projectiles. It deals continuous damage to sticky opponents for 5 seconds. It also penetrates armor of armored mages and inflicts physical damage.

Enemies

 When a red mage is attacked, flames cling to him and he takes continuous damage. If the enemy is hit by sliding, tactical sprinting, or a blowout attack, the clinging flames will disappear.
 The voice of the enemy when he dies has been increased.
 Items dropped by floating enemies have been changed from gibs to armor.

Other

 Gib now bounce.
 A blood mist now occurs when an enemy is killed with a rocket weapon.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a problem with punch charge attacks slipping through walls.
 Fixed an issue where the game would freeze when erasing some blocks in the training area.
 Fixed an issue where in rare cases, landing would not be detected and the player would slide on the floor.
 Fixed an issue where key bindings for weapon 1 would not work.

notes.title: Update 0.38.0
notes.content:
Additional Elements

 When running out of stamina, tactical sprints and wall runs are now limited until stamina is restored.
 Freezing an enemy with the "freezegrenade"now causes an explosion that freezes the surrounding area when the enemy is defeated.

Balance adjustments

 Reduced "pistol" speed from 1.0 m per frame to 0.75 m per frame.
 reduced "handcannon" speed from 1.25m to 1.0m per frame
 Horde mode time reduction moderation rate changed from 0.1sec per weapon to 0.05sec per weapon.

Bug fixes

 "punch" now moves to the correct position during a charge attack.
 Fixed an issue with clusterbow bullet reflections.
 Recoil now works correctly.
 Gameplay settings were not being applied correctly when starting Episode 1 after the tutorial.

notes.title: Update 0.37.1
notes.content:
Bug fixes

 Fixed a problem that caused the player to become invincible.
 Fixed algorithm for determining where bullets land.

Tutorial

 Some confusing level design has been improved.

Settings

 Added mipmap option to reduce flickering in the distance.
 Added a way to return to the menu in the playback instructions.

notes.title: Update 0.37.0
notes.content:
Episode Mode

 Fixed problem with intermission screen not displaying.

Horde Mode

 Sidearms have been added to the weapon deployment.
 It is now possible to disable weapons, and disabling weapons now reduces the time reduction by 0.1x per weapon.

Weapons

 Improved problem with punch charges not hitting.
 Fixed an issue where clicking immediately after a charge attack would immediately complete the charge.

Graphics

 Many resolution settings have been added for each aspect.
 Fixed a mistake in the code for supersampling.
 Fixed a pixel shift problem when checkerboard rendering is turned on and reflections and shadows are turned off.
 Graphics code has been reorganized.

Other

 Many bugs were fixed.

notes.title: Update 0.36.1
notes.content:
Changed the "launcher" charge shot to fire without lock-on.
 Adjusted horde mode boner skills, changing "armor break" to 7.5 seconds and "shoot down" to 10 seconds.
 Fixed an issue with projectile judgments.

notes.title: Update 0.36.0
notes.content:
Weapons

 The launcher's charge shot has been changed to eject multiple mini-missiles with tracking capabilities at the locked-on enemy. When a locked-on enemy is killed, it will track another enemy in sight.

Controls

 The wheel menu has been changed to a cursor-select format.

Other

 Numerous bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: hotfix
notes.content: Fixed problem with enemies and objects not blowing up

notes.title: update 0.35.2
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where key icons in the UI would appear shrunken.
 A cursor has been added to the wheel menu to facilitate selection with the mouse.

notes.title: update 0.35.1
notes.content:
Fixed a problem with objects sticking to the ceiling
 Fixed a problem with upscaling not working

notes.title: update 0.35.0
notes.content:
Movement system

 Leaning now maintains sprint status.
 While cliff climbing, it is now possible to cancel by making a move input in the opposite direction.


Weapons

 The rocket launcher charge is now a two-point burst with a high bullet velocity.
 Scope peering speed no longer decreases during slow motion.
 The movement system when using a hookshot has been changed to accelerate in the direction it is pointed, similar to APEX and Halo Infinite.


Performance

 Added internal resolution and checkerboard rendering to settings. Reducing the internal resolution will upscale to the original resolution. Checkerboard rendering upscales the number of pixels to be rendered by 1/2. When enabled, both of these upscale from 1/6 of the original resolution, greatly reducing the GPU load.


Other

 Upscaling is now turned off when CRT is enabled.
 Numerous bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: update 0.34.0
notes.content:
Saves are now made on a checkpoint-by-checkpoint basis, and you can choose to start from a checkpoint when resuming.
 Gameplay options are now tied to saved data. It is no longer possible to change gameplay options mid-game.

notes.title: hotfix
notes.content: Improved the problem of frames being displayed with a delay.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: The problem of bullets hitting enemies behind the targeted enemy has been improved.

notes.title: update 0.33.1
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where killing an armored mage would be counted as a kill.
 Fixed an issue where some theme colors were not reflected.

notes.title: update 0.33.0
notes.content:
Interface

 Japanese is now supported.


Level Design

 Added a kill combo section to the tutorial map.


Weapons

 Heavy cannons, monocular, and combo boosters are no longer slowed down even when in slow motion.
 Shotguns now have a weaker reticle contraction than chain shotguns.
 Launcher charge attacks now send five small rockets flying.
 Fixed an issue where movement restrictions were in effect when using hookshot.
 Hookshot can now be canceled with a firing input.


Player.

 The viewpoint can now be moved against the directional correction during a wall run.
 Fixed a problem with the wall run direction correction not working in some situations.
 Weapon mount judgments have been improved.


Enemies

 Enemies used to drop more grams of meat the higher the combo rank, but this specification has been removed because it was confusing.


Other

 Numerous bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: update 0.32.2
notes.content:
Adjusted ammunition placement on horde map island
 Fixed some bugs

notes.title: update 0.32.1
notes.content:
Increased the number of ammunition sponers placed on some horde maps.
 The map names on the results screen for horde maps are now displayed correctly.
 Fixed some of the episodic maps.
 Fixed performance issues.

notes.title: Update 0.32.0
notes.content:
Level Design

 The tutorial has been reworked and the maps are now separated by category and can be skipped.
 Horde map names are no longer numbered.

Weapons

 The main relationship between "machingun" and "smg" has been reversed, so that by default you get "smg".
 When crouching or leaning over, the reticle will now follow the enemy when pointed at the reticle.
 Weapon mounts now follow the reticle's starting position.
 The explosion range of the "freeze grenade" has been increased.

Horde Mode

 A "bonus rate" has been added that doubles the time taken at night.

Miscellaneous

 Native Linux builds are now supported.
 Native Linux builds now work with SteamDeck.
 Fixed an issue where the game would not stop when a Steam overlay was displayed.
 Numerous bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: update 0.31.3
notes.content:
The program for ballistic calculations has been modified.
 The limit on the number of combo chain in horde mode has been removed.

notes.title: update 0.31.2
notes.content:
Stamp flickering has been improved.
 Charging during a wall run now causes the hand to move out.
 Fixed an issue where large bullets would hit enemies directly behind you.

notes.title: update 0.31.1
notes.content: Fixed problem with some effects not disappearing

notes.title: update 0.31.0
notes.content:
Levels

 Tutorial content has been revised.


Player

 The time required to climb a cliff is now reduced depending on the height of the starting point. This shortening efficiency depends on the rank of the kill combo.
 When mounted, the position of the mount can now be changed with a move input.


Weapons

 The second weapon has been revised. This is due to feedback that it had been difficult to use for some time.

[olist]
 The magazine weapon has been changed to a smg, which has a higher rate of fire than the machinegun, but is less powerful and less efficient.
 Changed shell weapon to chainshotgun.
 The clusterbow of the rocket weapon has been enhanced.
 Changed cell weapon to heavycannon. Long pressing the fire button fires a laser. This laser penetrates walls and has a thick bullet.
[/olist]

 Balance of weapons has been adjusted.


Enemies

 Added damage accumulation parameter to enemies. This can be accumulated by the cell weapon. If an enemy is defeated while accumulating damage, an explosion with an attack power equal to the amount of damage inflicted will occur.


Configuration

 Added free lean/mount toggle operation item.


Miscellaneous

 Added support for joystick operation for menu operations.
 SteamDeck can now be played by specifying "proton" in the compatibility options of the Steam client. (This is not fully supported.)
 Numerous bugs have been fixed.

notes.title: update 0.30.3
notes.content:
GPU memory usage has been reduced by introducing a mechanism to reuse GPU resources.
 To enhance the immersive experience, a fade-in effect that occurs at start and respawn has been added.

notes.title: Hitfix
notes.content:
Addressed a problem with some systems not booting.
 Added "low latency api" to settings.

notes.title: update 0.30.2
notes.content: Fixed code that caused enemies to become invincible.

notes.title: update 0.30.1
notes.content: ピックアップフラッシュの点滅を、控えめに調整しました。

notes.title: update 0.30.0
notes.content:
Enemy

 When an enemy is killed with the cell weapon, an explosion will occur, causing minor damage to the surrounding area. Also, they now drop Gibs with magical properties, which heal armor when picked up.
 When an enemy is killed with an explosion or cell weapon, it will now drop a lit gib. Fiery gibs restore energy.
 Frozen flesh now restores armor as well as stamina.

Weapons

 The Clusterbow's child warhead now traces a path, making it easier to be aware of its trajectory.
 Clusterbow's charge shot has been changed to a StickyBomb. It glues to the point of impact and causes an explosion 1.5 seconds later.
 The muzzle flash has been reimplemented and the light now glows when fired.
 A hit sound now sounds when an enemy is damaged.
 The hit marker now rotates when you hit with a series of attacks

Horde Mode

 Explosion combos   Weapons that use rocket ammunition could only be used to take down airborne enemies until now. Explosion combos are now used with rocket weapons, where the more enemies you kill with the rocket weapon, the more chains you get, and if you perform a bonus skill when the chains are overlapping, the time you gain is doubled (up to 25) by the number of chains you have.
 Weapon Sponer   Weapons of the same category will now spawn after being acquired. Also, the later you acquire a weapon, the later the second weapon will spawn, so you will have to use trial and error to decide which one to acquire first.

Graphics

 Damage stamps now appear in all three directions.
 Damage stamps now fade out when they disappear.
 The sun and moon have been adjusted to make their movements more realistic.

Sound

 Hit sounds are no longer slowed down when in slow motion.

Bug Fixes

 The problem where enemy hit detection would disappear at a certain probability has been fixed.
 Sprites behind the camera are now culled correctly.
 Using a hand weapon during a wall run now brings the hand to the screen.

notes.title: update 0.29.6
notes.content:
We have added a setting to the program to give priority to the graphics board inserted in the PC. (If your graphics card is not being used and you are not experiencing performance, please contact us via the Steam forums for assistance.)
 Fixed a minor bug in the renderer.
 Fixed an issue where enemy kills were not being counted.

notes.title: update 0.29.5
notes.content:
Improved performance.
 fixed small bugs.

notes.title: update 0.29.4
notes.content: Fixed a renderer bug.

notes.title: update 0.29.3
notes.content: Improved operation of weapon mounts

notes.title: update 0.29.2
notes.content: Fixed a problem where the game would not start if an unsupported API was specified. (If you get an error saying "Not support this hardware", try starting the game again.)

notes.title: update 0.29.1
notes.content: fix many bugs.

notes.title: Update 0.29.0
notes.content:
Added weapon mount to operation.
 Added screen effect while getting shield
 Reviewed the setting items.
 Fixed many bugs.

notes.title: Update 0.28.2
notes.content:
Adjustments

 Drum explosions have been changed to colossal.
 The weapons you have are now swapped depending on the input type.

Bug fixes

 Fixed an issue where the ceiling would catch you when you hit it during a wall run.
 Fixed an issue with weapon wheel fire key selection.

notes.title: Update 0.28.1
notes.content:
Bug fixes

 Fixed function to determine if it is possible to climb with a grab.
 Fixed issue with melee armor mages not dying.

notes.title: update 0.28.0
notes.content:
Weapons

 Blocking an attack with an energy shield now generates a special sound effect and shaking to make it easier to recognize.
 While holding a weapon, the zoom is now 1.5x when leaning and 1.25x when crouching.

Parkou

 An icon now appears in the reticle when a grab jump is possible.

Store

 During episodic play, it is no longer necessary to re-purchase a weapon once it has been purchased.
 Sound effects now change between purchase and reacquisition.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where enemies would not perform path searching under certain conditions.
 Fixed an issue where the number of enemies remaining and items acquired were not displayed on the map clear screen.
 Fixed an issue where armor fragments were light blue in color.
 Removed the white edge that appeared when freezing a floating enemy.
 Fixed an issue where some holes could not be dived into.

Performance

 The code has been significantly reworked and refactored by about 75% of the total to greatly improve performance.

notes.title: Update 0.27.0
notes.content:
Weapons

 The weapon system has been expanded to support burst firing.
 It is now possible to sprint and tactical sprint while charging.
 Charge attacks have been added to all semi-automatic weapons.
 Releasing the button while charging will fire, but this has been changed so that the weapon will not fire.
 Charging is now possible even when ammunition is low.
 The reticle now looks circular when using weapons that diffuse bullets.
 The color of the bullets and muzzle flash of weapons that use "cell" has been unified to purple. 
 While using "monocular" weapons, the remaining amount of stamina is now displayed for easier confirmation.
 The "corrode grenade" was removed because it was useless when used in horde mode.
 A new "freeze grenade" has been added. It can immobilize enemies within the blast radius for 5 seconds, and defeated enemies will drop a special "freeze gib" that restores armor in addition to strength. The player can also fly high with a blast that occurs only to the player.
 The "hand cannon" is now a point-blast for normal fire and a spread charge, with a firing interval of 0.25 seconds.
 The "slow ball" and "enegy shield" now zoom 1.1x when in use.
 When using the "monocular," "slow ball," or "enegy shield," the remaining amount of "energy" is now also displayed near the center of the screen.

Items
The sound effects for acquiring armor and energy have been changed to make it easier to distinguish which resource is being acquired.

Enemies

 Red enemy bullets have been changed to flame, and their damage type has been changed to "flame" which ignores armor.
 Changed enemies weak to "rocket" to glow light yellow and enemies weak to "cell" to glow purple.

Maps
Added new tiles to E1M1-E1M4 to increase visual variation.

Other

 Fixed an issue where sliding animations were not working properly
 The determined tilt direction is now fixed when auto-lean is performed
 When auto-leaning, azimuths exceeding 90 degrees are now canceled.

notes.title: update 0.26.4
notes.content:
Horde Mode
[olist]
 The shotgun placed in Horde3 has been changed to a heavycannon.
 Fixed so that scores are not added upon death or termination.
[/olist]
Graphics
Fixed a voxel drawing error that occurred when ANGLE used DX11.
Performance
A number of functions that were adversely affecting performance have been removed.

notes.title: Update 0.26.3
notes.content:
Enemies
Headshot targets have been adjusted to match their appearance.

Bug fix
[olist]
 Fixed a problem in which subsequent fire inputs were not accepted when a hand cannon, hayvy cannon, or cluster bow was selected with the weapon wheel by pressing the fire key.
 Fixed problem with sprint motion not playing while weapon wheel is open.
[/olist]

notes.title: update 0.26.2
notes.content:
Campaign Mode
Fixed directions have been added to checkpoints so that they now face the direction of travel when respawning.

Player Behavior
[olist]
 Fixed an issue where the player could not change posture while leaning out of the air.
 Fixed an issue where the cliff grabbing action would be triggered later when climbing a step.
[/olist]
Weapons
[olist]
 Fixed an issue where the Clusterbow would reflect in the wrong direction when hitting an object or enemy.
 Changed the design of the PlasmaSMG sprite.
[/olist]
Settings
Added option to turn off enemy voices. This was due to feedback that the enemy voices were annoying.
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where the PC itself would freeze if multiple Clusterbow bullets or child warheads were sent off the map.

notes.title: update 0.26.1
notes.content:
Bug fixes
[olist]
 Fixed an issue where combos would not add up if an enemy was killed with clusterbow's small warhead.
 Fixed an issue where blood stamps would not resize correctly.
[/olist]

notes.title: update 0.26.0
notes.content:
Weapons
[olist]
 binoculars (binoculars) renamed to monoculars.
 Fixed an issue where fov would change the sensibility while using a monocular.
 Removed headshot detection from the handcannon.
[/olist]
Enemies
[olist]
 Fixed an issue with unstable attack judgments for enemies attacking up close.
 Blood stamps generated when defeating enemies are now resized by terrain to make them less likely to stick out.
[/olist]
Level
[olist]
 The secret map for Episode 2 has been adjusted to make it less prone to errors.
 Fixed an issue where more playtime was displayed for each level at the end of an episode.
[/olist]
Performance
A new setting has been added to change the WebGL backend to Vulkan. Also, a restart is required to apply the change.

Settings
[olist]
 Changed the layout of the settings screen to be as clear as possible.
 Changed configuration parameters from LocalStorage to setting.json. Also, this will reset the settings once.
[/olist]
BugFix
The folder generated by the application used to be "v.r.g." but was changed to "vrg" after it was pointed out that folders ending with "." are not recommended on Windows. was changed to "vrg" after it was pointed out that folders ending with "." are not recommended on Windows.
Also, the "v.r.g." folder cannot be deleted in Explorer, so please refer to the following SteamForum thread if you wish to delete it.
(https://steamcommunity.com/app/1693090/discussions/0/3317484899030484720/)

notes.title: update 0.25.2
notes.content:
Bug fixes
[olist]
 Fixed game loop code to improve stuttering issues.
[/olist]
Frame rate
[olist]
 Electron's frame rate is now limited to 240; unlimited frame rates are no longer allowed.
 Changed frame rate setting to allow selection from 30 60 144 240.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 0.25.1
notes.content:
Bug fixes
[olist]
 Fixed an issue where the frame rate would drop when switching tasks.
 Fixed an issue where the game would indeterminately go to sleep and not recover when task switching was performed.
[/olist]

Other
[olist]
 Updated electron version to 17.4.11.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 0.25.0
notes.content:
Operability
[olist]
 Changed wall run not to work when looking down.
 Fixed problem with not being able to clutch while leaning.
[/olist]
Items
[olist]
 A recovery item has been added in addition to meat.
[/olist]
Weapons
[olist]
 Removed slow motion function of binoculars for balance adjustment.
 Removed the charge function of the handcannon and changed the attack power to 5 x 8.
 The number of ammunition consumed by the chainshotgun has been reduced to 3, and its attack power has been changed to 16 x 6.
 Removed the charge function of the heavycannon and changed its attack power to 45 x 7
[/olist]
Weapon Wheel
[olist]
 Fixed an issue with a delay in the display when opening the weapon wheel after using the store.
 Added weapon wheel dead zone to settings.
[/olist]
Store
[olist]
 A new item category has been added and recovery items can now be purchased.
[/olist]
Practice Area
[olist]
 Added a "door block" in the editor that can be erased with the Use key.
[/olist]
Horde Mode
[olist]
 Added ranks SS and SSS. This was done to make them equivalent to kill combo ranks and to make them more intuitive.
 Added a gauge to show respawn time for item spawners.
 Item spawner items now float, improving visibility.
 Changed the color of the sponer for different item categories.
[/olist]
Graphics
[olist]
 Bleeding enemies now leave a blood stamp when defeated.
 Added a foot sprite that appears when coiling while holding a weapon.
[/olist]
Performance
[olist]
 Improved frame rate limiting functionality.
 Fixed a bug in the collision system.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 0.24.0
notes.content:
Movement System
[olist]
 Fixed a problem in which the viewpoint correction for wall runs did not function properly.
[/olist]
Weapons System
[olist]
 The bullet system has been reorganized to fix an issue where weapons that fire multiple rounds, such as the shotgun in "binoculars," would only land one shot.
 The attack power of the "heavycannon" has been changed from 15 x 7 to 25 x 7.
 Separated weapon and muzzle flash sprites and added multiple muzzle flash patterns.
 Weapon sprites have been adjusted to reflect the addition of muzzle flash patterns.
 Some weapon designs have been changed.
 Auto lean judging has been improved.
 Fixed an issue where auto-lean would not function properly in some directions.
[/olist]
Horde Mode
[olist]
 Weapon placement in horde3 has been changed.
[/olist]
Drawing
[olist]
 Added "Lighting Dethering" option to reduce load by thinning out lighting by pixels.
 Revised shading program to improve frame rate by about 10%.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 0.23.3
notes.content:
Movement
[olist]
 Grabs have been modified to automatically climb if there is nothing overhead. This change was made to prevent the grabbing state from accidentally triggering when the fight is intense.
[/olist]
UI
[olist]
 Horde mode status is now displayed during respawn after a fall.
[/olist]
Horde Mode
[olist]
 The horde mode now spawns enemies if the spawner is behind them, but this has been removed.
 The sky no longer moves during gadget selection.
 Added an armor spawner to the map.
 Added cliff and wall run textures to the map.
 Enemies now move away from the spawner and are less likely to overlap with other enemies.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 0.23.2
notes.content:
バグフィックス
[olist]
 ショップのセールの時間がずれている問題を修正しました。
[/olist]
グラフィックス
[olist]
 スカイボックスの地平線がフェードアウトしてしまってる問題を修正しました。
 ソフトシャドウが正しく機能するようになりました。
 ラフネスブラーが遮蔽度を考慮するようになりました。
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 0.23.1
notes.content:
Horde Mode
[olist]
 because there was a bias in the number of spawners that spawn enemies, the spawners with the lowest number of spawns have been given priority. Also, a limit of 5 enemies can be spawned per spawner.
[/olist]
Bug Fixes
[olist]
 Fixed an issue where the store would have half-price sales during the day.
 Fixed an issue where the tutorial options were reversed when selecting Episode 1.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update 0.23.0
notes.content:
Horde Mode
[olist]
 map "Horde3" is added.
[/olist]
Weapons
[olist]
 changed the attack power of heavy cannon from 70 to 105. 2.
 adjusted weapon sprites

Graphics

 modified the night sky horizon to be brighter
 added stars in the night sky. 3. restored CheckerBoardRendering.
 modified the restoration algorithm of CheckerBoardRendering to improve performance.

Settings

 Pixelized Lighting has been removed.

notes.title: update 0.21.1
notes.content:
Bug fix

 Fixed a situation where switching between mouse and gamepad was not possible.
[/olist]

notes.title: update 0.21.0
notes.content:
feeling of shooting
[olist]
 when firing, only the camera now moves backward and returns to normal after a period of time.

Graphics

 the bloom effect has been corrected to the correct algorithm and now appears thinner and wider

 the PBR algorithm has been corrected so that the material now displays correctly 4. the AO algorithm has been corrected

 many textures and materials have been adjusted.

notes.title: update 0.20.0
notes.content:
Player
[olist]
 if the player's health is below 50, it will now automatically recover to 50 after 5 seconds have passed since the damage was taken. (The number is only provisional and may be adjusted in the future.)
 the playtime count will now stop while accessing the store.
[/olist]
Weapons

notes.title: HordeMode Update 0.13.0
notes.content:
Update 0.13.0 will add a new game mode, Horde Mode.

Overview
This horde mode is inspired by the previous generation of ResidentEvil's Mercenaries mode, and is designed to be played in about 5 minutes. It was inspired by the old generation of ResidentEvil's Mercenaries mode.

Rules
At the beginning, players are given a goal to kill 150 monsters and a time limit of one minute. When the player finally achieves the goal or the time limit is up, the game ends, and the player's score and rank are determined accordingly. The maximum rank is "S".

Detailed game system
You can extend the time limit slightly by killing enemies with headshots, removing armor from armor monsters, and defeating flying monsters.
You can extend the time limit slightly by killing enemies with headshots, removing armor, and defeating flying enemies. The weapons on the map have finite ammunition (pistols with infinite ammunition have been removed), so you'll need to use parkour to replenish your supply regularly.

Other updates/fixes
Game related items

 Removed armlauncher and added corrodegrenade instead. It throws a parabolic grenade that explodes on impact. It deals armor damage to enemies and leaves a damage stamp.
 When resurrected at a checkpoint, Previously, all ammunition in your possession was recovered, but now the recovery amount has been halved.
 When resurrected at a checkpoint, the combo rank and combo gauge will now be initialized.
 Changed the amount of damage stamps left by players and enemies to a maximum of five, with any more disappearing in order of oldest to newest. This is an adjustment for Horde mode.
 Changed the damage stamps so that even if there are multiple overlapping damage stamps, it will still be one time damage.
 Changed to limit the height at which the damage stamps remain.
 Fixed an issue where changing the weapon of the opposite arm when using combobooster would cancel it.
 Fixed an issue where damage from proximity enemies would be lost.

Sound and image related issues.

 Changed to erase the old SE every time the enemy shooting SE is sounded, to improve the problem of too much audio not sounding.
 Adjusted the text when the game is over.
 Fixed an issue where the font "@" was not displayed.

notes.title: Demo update 0.2.3
notes.content:
Hitting a wall while looking down no longer results in a wall run.
 Fixed an issue where the weapon switch on the weapon wheel would not remember the weapon correctly under some conditions.
 In the clear screen, the score and other information is now more compact.

notes.title: Demo update 0.2.2
notes.content:
Weapon animations have been adjusted overall.
 Now automatically grabs you when you hit a cliff while in the air.
 Now pauses to show menu when switching tasks.
 Fixed an issue where sensibility would change depending on the number of updates.
 The number of updates used to be unlimited, but now it is limited to the same number of updates as the set frame rate (the minimum number of updates is 60), because the load becomes much higher on high-spec PCs.

notes.title: Demo update 0.2.1
notes.content:
Enemies
To improve gameplay, we changed the height of each type of enemy with a head. This will make it harder to do headshots with the reticle in the same position.

Fixes

 Placed additional meat on each level to make it easier to rank up member's cards.
 Fixed a slow loading issue when retrying and map data is large.
 Fixed an issue where briefly pressing the weapon wheel key would equip the previous weapon set, but would not remember the weapon set correctly in some situations.
 Fixed an issue where thick projectiles would stop when they hit the corner of a block.

notes.title: Demo update 0.2.0
notes.content:
Shop
A member's card has been implemented, with ranks and discounts on products based on points spent.

Control

 Fixed an issue where running "Retry" would cause the viewpoint to keep moving at random times.
 Fixed a bug that occurred when grabbing and going through a hole of one block.


HUD
Some items are now hidden when the Weapon Wheel is open and when the store is open.

notes.title: Demo update 0.1.7
notes.content:
Save
Lightly pressing the Weapon Wheel key will equip the previous weapon set, but the save data will now record this weapon set.

Lean
now takes a little longer to return to its original position when you deactivate it, instead of returning to it without delay.

Grab
When standing up over a wall, even though you didn't press the move key, it would still go over the wall, but now it doesn't.

notes.title: Demo update 0.1.6
notes.content:
hookshot

 Fixed an issue where the grab decision would be corrected while using "hookshot", but it would grab through the ground.
 Fixed an issue where using "hookshot" while grounded would not result in a slip.


binoculars
Fixed an issue where zooming would be canceled when "stamina" was lost.

Continue
Fixed an issue where actors would spawn one block above you when you continue.

Returning from a fall
Fixed an issue where enemy attacks would not hit you if you remained motionless when recovering from a fall.

notes.title: Demo update 0.1.5
notes.content:
Weapons.

 Fixed an issue that prevented you from shooting if you obtained ammo while holding a weapon with no ammo.
 Hookshots can no longer be resisted with the move key or move stick.


Enemies.
Fixed an issue where enemies would search for a point where they could hide from the player if they couldn't search the movement path to the attack range, but would keep searching forever.

HUD.
Weapons that do not have enough ammunition to fire will now have a dark red ammo count indicator.

notes.title: Demo update 0.1.4
notes.content:
Weapons

 Fixed an issue where the "chainshotgun" would not fire.
 Fixed an issue where weapons that work by holding down a button, such as "punch", would stop while the weapon wheel was open.


Physics

 Fixed an issue where the movement path of enemy characters could not be explored when they were hit by objects.
 Fixed an issue where physics objects, enemies, and players spawned while hitting an object would not repel the object.


Controls

 Pressing the fire key while holding down a weapon number that you do not possess no longer fires.
 Going up a cliff while grabbing its edge no longer causes a crouching motion.


Controller

 Added "Movement" and "Weapon" to bind items.
 When operating the keyboard, the game will no longer pause when the controller is disconnected.

notes.title: Demo update 0.1.3
notes.content:
Fixed an issue where the frame rate limit was not working.
 Firing input is no longer accepted while the weapon wheel is open.

notes.title: Demo update 0.1.2
notes.content:
Performance
When the frame rate was set to as low as 30, the frequency of game updates was reduced, which caused problems such as slowing down the rate of fire of weapons. Therefore, the frequency of game updates is now unlimited, and only graphics updates are limited to the set frame rate.

Graphics
The weapon's muzzle flash will now light up the surroundings. At the same time, a muzzle flash item has been added to the graphics settings.

notes.title: Demo update 0.1.1
notes.content: Fixed a problem where "slowball" and "binoculars" could not be used.

notes.title: Update 0.1.0
notes.content:
Weapons

Added new weapon "handcannon".
Preempted accepting fire inputs during weapon fire animations to make it easier to input continuous fire.
When falling and respawning, pooling attacks such as "punch" will now be canceled without consuming resources.
Fixed an issue where the "chainshotgun" roll would not be maintained.
Slowball in use has a reticle that shrinks while, making it easier to use.
 "binoculars" can now maintain zoom even when "stamina" is off.
Plasma weapons used to be 1.5 times stronger on armor and 0.5 times stronger on health, but since they were more difficult to use than other weapons, they now deal 1 times damage to everything.
The explosion detection was not centered, which prevented damage in some situations, but this has been fixed.


Sound Effects
Fixed a problem where footsteps would not sound when "camera bob" was turned off.

Graphics

 Fixed an issue where repeated changes to the settings would result in incorrect rendering.
 Fixed an issue where switching the CRT filter would cause the screen display to stop working.


Miscellaneous
Electron has been updated to 14.0.0.

notes.title: Demo update 0.0.15
notes.content:
Rendering

When switching graphics settings, the game will no longer freeze when returning to the game.
Fixed a mistake in the AO code.

notes.title: Demo update 0.0.14
notes.content:
Tureal, HUD

 The keys or buttons required for operation are now enclosed in parentheses to make them easier to identify.
 The message will now switch when the operating device is switched.


Weapons.

 Guns no longer emit an out of ammo sound when punching lacks stamina.
 Changed the damage calculation for plasma weapons. (Armor: x 1.5, Health: x 0.5)


Wall Run.
It is now harder to be canceled when straddling a wall at different angles.

notes.title: Demo update 0.0.13
notes.content:
Tutorial

Added descriptions to each point.
Added a tutorial on gun shooting.

Weapons

For balancing purposes after Episode 2, punches have been changed to consume stamina when charged.
The child warheads of ClusterBow bullets have been modified to have the Explode attribute.

Rendering

Optimized the Pixelize filter.
Wands dropped by enemies are now outlined in yellow to make them easier to recognize as items.

Controls
Fixed a mistake in the code for gamepad movement controls.

notes.title: Demo update 0.0.12
notes.content:
Graphics

 Added Pixelize filter to simplify lighting to texture resolution.
 Added a "Pixelize" item to the graphics settings.


Operations
Slightly widened the range of sticks from which the controller sprint is released.

notes.title: Demo update 0.0.11
notes.content:
Enemy AI
For difficulty adjustment, green enemies that shoot tracking bullets will now stop when shooting.

Performance
Optimized the code for some line judgments (such as enemy visibility).

Graphics

Fixed some graphics code errors.
Reduced flickering of ground bumps.

notes.title: Demo update 0.0.10
notes.content:
Fixed some rendering code mistakes.
 Fixed the problem that input occurs in the forward direction at regular intervals when retreating by stick operation.

notes.title: Demo update 0.0.9
notes.content:
Graphics

Fixed an error in graphics code.
Improved bloom code.


Enemies
Fixed an issue where helmets would disappear when melee attacking enemies ran out of health, and can now be obtained again as armor.

Grappling Hook

Changed to reduce the speed at which you can attract enemies, and gradually increase the speed at which you can attract them.
When hooked into a wall, the speed at which it pulls will now gradually increase.

notes.title: Demo update 0.0.8
notes.content:
Drawing 
Fixed some rendering code mistakes.

 Settings 
Added bloom, roughness, and soft shadow to the graphic options.

 Game system 
Fixed a mistake in the code of the action that goes into the hole.

notes.title: Demo update 0.0.7
notes.content:
Fixed some incorrect code for graphics
 During the coil, if you do not shift to sliding when you reach the ground, you will now be in a crouching state.

notes.title: Demo update 0.0.6
notes.content:
Fixed a mistake in the graphics code.
 Fixed an issue where the enemy AI couldn't find a route and got stuck in some situations.

notes.title: Demo update 0.0.5
notes.content:
Drawing

 Fixed a mistake in the code for roughness and shadow blur.
 Introduced a light load and easy-to-see bloom.
 The timing to update the position of the decorative billboard of the projectile has been changed so that it is performed only during drawing to reduce the load.

level


 The passages and spaces of E1M1 and E2M2 have been widened a little.
 Widened the area where some parts of E1M3 can be grabbed.

notes.title: Demo update 0.0.4
notes.content:
Fixed the algorithms that make up the map to improve drawing performance.
 Fixed an issue an actor would not blow off when hitting where Arm Launcher rockets.
 Meat pieces and armor spawned from enemies have been changed so that they cannot be acquired for 0.5 seconds after they appear to make it easier to understand the effect of defeating them.
 Changed the behavior of shifting to sliding when landing on the ground during the coil so that it shifts when a certain force is applied.
 Adjusted the tactical sprint animation for the chain shotgun.

notes.title: Demo update 0.0.3
notes.content:
E1M4: Made it hard to get lost to Larger small room. 
E1M5: Adjusted the location where you can easily die when you play for the first time.
Overall Level: The explosive drums have been repositioned to make them easier to aim and Increased the amount.
Fixed a minor grab bug.
No longer slides if the move key or stick is not tilted while coiling.
Fixed an issue where the number of digits would be abnormally high if the enemy subjugation rate and the placed meat acquisition rate were odd on the result screen.
Larger projectile is no overlap.

notes.title: Demo update 0.0.2
notes.content:
Reduced item pickup flash.
Fixed an issue where retreating during a sprint would not cancel sprint it.
If you hit a half-sized wall during a wall run, it will now be canceled correctly.

notes.title: Demo update 0.0.1
notes.content:
Steam Overlay has been turned off to fix some "screen blanks in the environment".
 Fixed a minor bug in the grab.
